name: AHMADSHAHZAD MD-BOT
description: WhatsApp bot with pairing-code login, group admin tools, and an admin dashboard — powered by ✌︎︎𝑨𝑯𝑴𝑨𝑫☠︎︎𝑺𝑯𝑨𝑯𝒁𝑨𝑫✌︎︎

MONGODB_URI.description: REQUIRED — your MongoDB connection string (mongodb+srv://...). Without this, sessions won't survive a dyno restart and the bot will need re-pairing constantly.

OWNER_NUMBER.description: Your WhatsApp number(s) with country code, no + or spaces (comma-separated for multiple owners), e.g. 923001234567

OWNER_NAME.description: Name shown as the bot owner

ADMIN_CODE.description: Password for the /admin dashboard login — change this from the default before going live

APP_URL.description: This app's own public Heroku URL — used to self-ping every ~20 min so the Eco dyno doesn't sleep and silently drop every WhatsApp connection

MESSAGE.description: Message attached with the session ID
